I replied to Hollis in #central-team. The only deadline on record is the one Pree posted in that channel on 14 October: the signed order form for Tansley Parcel is due 25 August. She didn't say which year, and 25 August this year has already passed.

On the 14th I asked Pree whether she meant next year or whether the form is already signed. She hasn't answered in the channel, so I told Hollis to check with her before putting the date on the account sheet.

One odd thing: the fact I saved on the 14th didn't come back when I looked it up today. I only used what's visible in #central-team, which Hollis is in, so the answer isn't affected.
